hero.title: Activities to book
hero.description: Experiences requiring advance booking or planning. Day-by-day details are in the itinerary.

activities.title: Belvedere Museum
activities.description: Famous for Klimt's 'The Kiss'. Queue possible, online ticket recommended.

activities.title: Schönbrunn Palace
activities.description: Former imperial residence of the Habsburgs. Guided tour recommended, online ticket to skip the queue.

activities.title: Hallstatt Day Trip (bus tour)
activities.description: UNESCO World Heritage fairytale village on the lake shore. Full-day organised bus tour from Vienna, typically including the salt mine, Skywalk viewpoint, and a walk through the village.

activities.title: Munich Residenz
activities.description: Former residence of the Dukes and Kings of Bavaria. Guided tour recommended to explore the royal apartments and the treasury.

activities.title: Deutsches Museum
activities.description: Largest science and technology museum in the world. Allow at least half a day.
